title: In vitro and in silico hybrid approach to unveil triterpenoids from Helicteres hirsuta leaves as potential compounds for inhibiting Nrf2.
authors: Nguyen, Minh Hien; Le, Nguyen Thien Han; Nguyen, Bui Quoc Huy; Nguyen, Mai Thanh Thi; Do, Truong Nhat Van; Le, Tho Huu; Nguyen, Vu Thanh; Yen, Chia-Hung
one_liner_zh: 该研究从植物中分离三萜类化合物，通过分子对接和动力学模拟评估其与PI3Kα受体结合以抑制Nrf2转录因子活性，虽涉及TF相关通路和分子模拟，但核心是化合物-受体对接而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Cancer is a leading global health concern, with over 20 million new cases and 9.7 million deaths reported in 2022. Chemotherapy remains a widely used treatment, but drug resistance, which affects up to 90% of treatment outcomes, significantly hampers its effectiveness. The transcription factor Nrf2, which is crucial for cellular defense against oxidative stress, plays a dual role in cancer treatment. Although Nrf2 activation can suppress early carcinogenesis, its overexpression in cancer cells contributes to drug resistance, resulting in poor patient outcomes. Thus, inhibiting Nrf2 has emerged as a promising strategy for overcoming cancer drug resistance. Natural compounds such as luteolin and brusatol have shown potential in inhibiting Nrf2, although with limitations. This study isolates and characterizes seven triterpenoids from the n-hexane sub-fraction of Helicteres hirsuta, a plant traditionally used for medicinal purposes, to evaluate their ability to modulate Nrf2 activity in Huh7 cancer and HaCaT normal cells. Additionally, molecular docking and dynamic simulations were utilized to assess the binding potential of these compounds to the PI3Kalpha receptor, which regulates downstream signaling pathways, thereby suppressing Nrf2 activity in cancer cells. Our findings provide insights into new strategies seeking triterpenoids as promising structures to reverse chemoresistance by regulating Nrf2. The results also reveal the potential of 3beta-O-trans-caffeoylbetulinic acid from H. hirsuta leaves as the unprecedented compound inhibiting Nrf2 activity, with an IC(50) of 74.5 mug mL(-1) in Huh7 cancer cells.
abstract_zh: 癌症是全球主要的健康问题，2022年报告了超过2000万新发病例和970万死亡病例。化疗仍是一种广泛使用的治疗方法，但药物耐药性影响了高达90%的治疗结果，显著削弱了其疗效。转录因子Nrf2对细胞抵御氧化应激至关重要，在癌症治疗中发挥双重作用。尽管Nrf2激活可抑制早期癌变，但其在癌细胞中的过表达却导致药物耐药性，造成患者预后不良。因此，抑制Nrf2已成为克服癌症药物耐药性的有前景策略。天然化合物如木犀草素（luteolin）和鸦胆子苦醇（brusatol）已显示出抑制Nrf2的潜力，尽管存在局限性。本研究从绒毛山芝麻（Helicteres hirsuta）的正己烷亚组份中分离并表征了七种三萜类化合物，该植物传统上用于药用目的，以评估其在Huh7癌细胞和HaCaT正常细胞中调节Nrf2活性的能力。此外，利用分子对接和动态模拟评估了这些化合物与PI3Kalpha受体的结合潜力，该受体调节下游信号通路，从而抑制癌细胞中的Nrf2活性。我们的发现为寻求三萜类化合物作为通过调节Nrf2逆转化疗耐药性的有前景结构提供了新策略的见解。结果还揭示了来自绒毛山芝麻叶片的3beta-O-trans-caffeoylbetulinic acid作为前所未有的抑制Nrf2活性的化合物的潜力，其在Huh7癌细胞中的IC(50)为74.5微克每毫升。
